position: An adapter contract should prove request shape and idempotency before it gains transport or provider authority
headline: One pseudonymous request becomes reviewable while token creation, delivery, provider mutation, and invitation issuance stay false.
copy: The adapter is deliberately fixture-only. It cannot receive an email address, create an account, connect to a provider, or send anything.

postures.title: Readiness
postures.copy: The candidate stack gate must pass first.

postures.title: Idempotency
postures.copy: Repeated preparation resolves to one request shape.

postures.title: Consent
postures.copy: Preparation cannot pretend consent has happened.

postures.title: Transport
postures.copy: No message or token leaves the repository.

flow.title: Inherit
flow.copy: Require the private stack readiness status.

flow.title: Describe
flow.copy: Use pseudonymous participant, role, purpose, and pending consent.

flow.title: Hash
flow.copy: Create one canonical idempotent request digest.

flow.title: Hold
flow.copy: Keep transport, delivery, provider, token, and issuance off.

decisions.label: Maximum requests
decisions.reason: No cohort or bulk path exists.

decisions.label: Provider mutations
decisions.reason: The adapter is a local fixture.

locks.title: Identity lock
locks.copy: Direct identity fields are rejected by every contract.

locks.title: Execution lock
locks.copy: No invitation, account, credential, participant, or live session is created.

locks.title: Provider lock
locks.copy: No provider mutation, delivery channel, or exported telemetry exists.

locks.title: Evidence lock
locks.copy: Only fixture evidence and canonical digests are produced.

locks.title: Public launch lock
locks.copy: Private evidence review cannot open public access.
